messages:
Ravi: Quick check-in on Optimize toolkit scope for beta. A few customers pushed for: per-tenant quant profiles, route-level batching presets, and an "eval -> alert" flow that surfaces regressions in Console. Need to pick what goes in beta vs incubator.
Leah: TL;DR: beta should include quant suggestions + a safe apply flow, and batching presets (not auto-tuning). Eval alerts can be beta if we gate to "ack-only" notifications (no auto-tickets).
Tomas: From infra: batching presets are low risk. Quant suggestions dangerous if users accidentally apply wide quant. We need a preview sim and a rollback path.
Nora: Suggestion: Beta cohort = three customers (ShopLoop, EduSpace, AcmeHealth). They get "apply to staging" toggle and an opt-in telemetry agreement.
DevOpsBot: Deploy scheduled: optimize-suggest-service v0.3 -> canary 2 nodes at 2026-04-02T09:00Z. Watch: memory + p99 latency.
Ravi: Minimal beta scope proposal: 1) Quant suggest engine (sample workload + accuracy estimate) + "Preview on staging" button, 2) Batching presets UI per-route with default profiles (low-latency, balanced, throughput), 3) Eval alerts (threshold-based, Console row + webhook) but initially "notify-only".
Leah: Acceptance criteria bullets I'm adding: - Quant preview with sample RAG workload and estimated token savings - Safety check that rejects suggestions with estimated accuracy delta > 0.8% - Batching presets implementable via SDK flag per-route - Eval alert path creates Console notification and a webhook payload
Tomas: Dev constraints: quant suggest engine needs a small profile job runner (can reuse existing profiler). ETA if scoped: 5w for engine + UI. Batching presets: 2w. Eval alerts infra: 3w (webhook + inbox). We can parallelize across 3 teams.
Nora: UX quick mock for batching presets:
```
Route: /chat/complete
Preset: [Low-latency] [Balanced] [Throughput]
Notes: Low-latency -> batch_size=8, target_p99=80ms
```
Keep presets editable per-route.
Ravi: Rollout plan idea: alpha (internal), closed beta (3 customers), Beta opt-in (all customers, notify-only), GA (auto-recommend + apply).
Leah: Rollback gates for GA: any quant that causes >1% absolute accuracy drop on nightly sample eval -> automatic suspend and email to customer + ops.
Tomas: Monitoring: per-tenant token-cost delta, model latency p95/p99, eval-fail-rate. Add a dashboard tile for "Optimize suggestions impact".
DevOpsBot: Alert: canary CPU at 85% during profiling job; auto-scale group +1 triggered.
EvalsBot: Eval run update: EduSpace sample set: 0.3% failing prompts, suggested threshold for alert=0.5%. Link: https://internal.evals/4124
Nora: Legal note: need opt-in language for data sampling in beta; I'll route to legal + privacy.
Ravi: Ok action items: Leah -> prod spec + acceptance criteria by Thu EOD; Tomas -> rough engineering timeline + team commits by Thu EOD; Nora -> legal opt-in copy by Fri. We'll lock beta scope after these.
Leah: Will share spec here: https://docs.internal/redwood/optimize/beta-scope-draft (ping when done).
Tomas: Adding: include a lightweight E2E test: run sample eval -> generate alert -> confirm webhook delivered.
Nora: +1 on E2E. Also request: list of customer data retention settings (for sampled traces).
Ravi: Thanks all. If no objections by Fri, we'll kick off. :rocket:
Leah: +1
Tomas: +1
Nora: +1
EvalsBot: Reminder: new eval alerts default to "notify-only" for beta and will not open incident tickets unless customer config allows.
